Body.Content:
Adding easy access to top sites in Edge search bar on desktop. Users can add, edit, remove, or hide top sites. Admins can control available to this feature using the NewTabPageManagedQuickLinks and NewTabPageQuickLinksEnabled policies.

GA date: January CY2027
